title: 2-Inch Solid Brass Robe Hook Wall Mount | Malibu Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop draping robes and towels over doors and counters. The Malibu robe hook adds a dedicated, easy-to-reach hanging spot with a compact profile that suits transitional bathrooms.

  • Keep towels and robes organized with a space-saving wall-mounted hook beside the shower, tub, or vanity
  • Count on sturdy everyday performance with solid brass construction
  • Create a coordinated look with the Malibu robe hooks collection—designed as transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
  • Match your bathroom hardware with multiple designer finish options available
  • Install with a clean, finished look using color-coordinated mounting hardware

Specs & Details
Dimensions (L x H x W): 2 in. x 2 in. x 2.64 in.
Box dimensions (L x H x W): 4 in. x 6 in. x 10 in.
Shipping weight: 1 lb.
Assembly: Assembled in the USA
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
